description: Applies one AiStreamDelta to an AiMessage and reports whether anything changed. Pure logic with no UI and no clock of its own (the caller passes the timestamp), so a WebAssembly host, a Server circuit and a unit test produce the same message; the boolean return lets a component skip a render for a no-op delta. A citation delta without a source or with an empty id is a no-op rather than an exception, and an error delta arriving after Completed or Stopped is ignored — a finished or stopped answer is never retroactively failed.
